title: Kizoku Tensei: Megumareta Umare kara Saikyou no Chikara wo Eru
synopsis: Noah Ararat is born into privilege as the 13th prince of an imperial dynasty and granted an existence most can only envy. After all, apart from the access to the empire's finest education and resource...
synopsis_es: Noah Ararat nace con el privilegio de ser el decimotercer príncipe de una dinastía imperial y se le concede una existencia que la mayoría sólo puede envidiar. Después de todo, aparte del acceso a la mejor educación y recursos del imperio...

episodes_data.title: Thirteenth Imperial Prince Noah Ararat
episodes_data.description: An ordinary village boy wakes up to find he`s been reborn as Noah Ararat, the thirteenth prince of the empire.

episodes_data.title: The Birth of the Songstress
episodes_data.description: While walking through the city, Noah enters a venue and is left speechless by the talent of a singer.

episodes_data.title: Those Gained, Those Lost
episodes_data.description: Noah gains another powerful subordinate, but suffers a blow when a rebellion breaks out in Almeria.

episodes_data.title: The Almerian Rebellion
episodes_data.description: Noah deals with the rebel forces leading an uprising in his domain.

episodes_data.title: People Are Treasures
episodes_data.description: Noah makes it his goal to show his thanks to the people who have given him their loyalty and cooperation.

episodes_data.title: Dark Clouds
episodes_data.description: Now twelve years old, Noah is recognized for his exceptional knowledge of military affairs and imperial law.

episodes_data.title: The Emperor's Wishes
episodes_data.description: When followers of the crown prince attempt an insurrection, Noah begins to question the emperor`s intentions.

episodes_data.title: The First Vesus the Thirteenth
episodes_data.description: Noah encounters a man doing evil deeds in the name of his brother Gilbert, the first prince.

episodes_data.title: The Highest Trust
episodes_data.description: Noah catches a spy in the act and learns of a plot against the emperor`s life.

episodes_data.title: Lightning Prince and Wise Prince
episodes_data.description: The emperor suggests a potential wife for Noah: the granddaughter of his uncle, Indra the Lightning Prince.

episodes_data.title: Disinheritance
episodes_data.description: The emperor makes the decision to disinherit the crown prince... but not before seeking Noah`s advice.

episodes_data.title: Nobility
episodes_data.description: Noah catches Albert in the act of attempting a coup and gives him one last chance to repent.
